'''Korrealis Systems''' was a company. Several [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] [[K-X12 probe droid]]s were associated with it.

==Behind the scenes==
The company is only mentioned once in [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]. The mention occurs if the player fails to repair two of the K-X12 probe droids, resulting in all four being destroyed and taking the life of [[Tanis Venn]] with them.
